Usage: droide doctor [options]

Diagnose configuration, connectivity, certificate, proxy, auth, and daemon
issues

Options:
  --json            Output results as JSON
  --verbose         Expand all checks with details, fixes, timings, and metadata
  --timeout <ms>    Per-probe timeout in milliseconds, cleanup included
                    (default: 10000; MCP server: 36000; exec full turn: 60000)
  --checks <names>  Run only these comma-separated checks: config, environment,
                    system, binaries, updates, filesystem, git, custom-models,
                    proxy, certs, connectivity, auth, daemon, inference, mcp,
                    exec. Use all to include checks that start servers or cost
                    FSC or provider money
  -h, --help        display help for command

By default, doctor runs every check except inference, custom-models, mcp, and exec.
MCP checks can start configured servers but call no tools.
Model checks can use FSC or provider money. Exec also runs normal startup hooks.
Example: droide doctor --checks config,connectivity,mcp
